message.content: {"A0100":"A0100 most plausibly sought head-on firing geometry through a fast descending northbound closure, then reduced direct exposure while supporting its missile by making a sustained hard right turn immediately after missile expenditure, coincident with B0200’s opposing launch.","A0200":"A0200 most plausibly sought to preserve attack geometry long enough to fire by maintaining the straighter northbound closure after A0100 turned away; after expending a missile, it began a gentler rightward offset, consistent with reducing head-on exposure while retaining pressure on the approaching opponents."}

answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly sought head-on firing geometry through a fast descending northbound closure, then reduced direct exposure while supporting its missile by making a sustained hard right turn immediately after missile expenditure, coincident with B0200’s opposing launch.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly sought to preserve attack geometry long enough to fire by maintaining the straighter northbound closure after A0100 turned away; after expending a missile, it began a gentler rightward offset, consistent with reducing head-on exposure while retaining pressure on the approaching opponents.
